observations.inpaint_hard_mask: The intended blue scarf and blue coat appear inside the ellipse, but the hard elliptical edge is conspicuous across the yellow sleeve/torso and even the pier background. The unchanged face outside the mask does not make the patch seamless.
observations.inpaint_feather24: The blue scarf/coat are drawn and the hard outline is softened; yellow-blue fuzzy/double boundaries remain near the shoulder and lower torso. This fixture does not establish a clean seam.
observations.lora_scale1: The LoRA visibly changes the masked region to a fuzzy gray/brown, horizontally striped wrap; the requested blue scarf is not retained in the same way. This demonstrates an effect, not improved prompt adherence or a preferred style.
observations.outpaint_bands: Band0 leaves clear straight vertical tone/geometry joins in sky and roof/boat edges. Band32 hides the obvious straight cut substantially in this scene. Bands64/128 change the new extension and blend wider portions of the source;128 has visible ghosted/double house-roof and mast structure. No universal best band or default change follows from one source and seed.
